build_note: Season 16: Yun Tal gives 0% crit (pure AS). Fix build: RFC second for 25% crit, Collector third for 50% crit before IE. Turret (Infernum crescendum) setup at chokepoints wins ARAM. Learn weapon rotations — Gravitum root into Infernum/Calibrum for combo kills.
vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 5th — Calibrum (sniper) shots apply LDR from safety
vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow 4th replaces The Collector vs heavy burst dive
kit_notes: Weapons cycle: Calibrum (long range), Severum (heals), Gravitum (slow/root), Infernum (AoE), Crescendum (turret). Ult varies by off-hand: Calibrum = mark all enemies, Infernum = AOE cone (best in ARAM), Gravitum = root all. Gravitum R into Infernum ult = root then AOE sweep.
aram_specific: Infernum (blue flame) ult in grouped ARAM = AOE sweep hitting everyone. Pre-stack Gravitum (grey chains) before fights for root. Place Crescendum turret at chokepoints during laning. Calibrum Q at max range for free poke between weapons.
